# Montana Wizard Podcast

> The Montana Wizard Podcast explores stories, ideas, and conversations from the wilds of Montana and beyond. Thoughtful discussion, offbeat humor, and a touch of wizardry from Big Sky Country.

The Montana Wizard Podcast is an independent podcast hosted from Montana, USA. New episodes are released bi-weekly. The show focuses on life in rural Montana, regional culture, conversations with interesting people, and stories that often don't make it into mainstream coverage of the American West.

## Episodes

- [Intro – What is this Podcast](https://montanawizard.com/episodes.html): A first dispatch introducing the show, the host, and the editorial approach.
- [Episode 1 – The Wizard Arrives](https://montanawizard.com/episodes.html): Pilot episode covering the origin of the show and a first long-form conversation.
- [Episode 2 – Relaxing in Montana](https://montanawizard.com/episodes.html): On rest, slowness, and the geography of leisure in Big Sky Country.
- [Episode 3 – Basketball Tournaments](https://montanawizard.com/episodes.html): The cultural significance of small-town high school basketball in Montana.
- [Episode 4 – Montana Scam](https://montanawizard.com/episodes.html): A field guide to scams that have rolled through Montana, and the locals who saw them coming.
